functions.title: Protected movement, safe separation and charging

configurations.initial_state: Empty qualified synthetic railway, then reserved train placement

hazards.consequence: Collision, derailment or unsafe charging departure

requirements.statement: Conflicting resources retain ownership through expiry, partition and restart; no conflicting occupancy.
Bounded position, integrity and speed must limit movement and inhibit/brake on invalid inputs.
Departure requires isolation, physical connector clearance, locked doors, usable authority and energy.
Recovery, maintenance, train division and rescue require qualified proving and privileged local procedure; no dashboard bypass.

failure_modes.environment: Synthetic two stations and one junction; HIL, rescue/depot/division qualification pending.
failure_modes.initiating_circumstances: Nominal running, charging, boundary straddling, partition or restart
causes: Sensor slip, loss, common supply, calibration drift
mechanisms: Loss of trusted bounded state or physical safe output
failure_modes.next_higher_effect: Parent subsystem cannot establish protected movement
failure_modes.system_effect: Unsafe separation, collision or charging interaction

detection.mechanism: Freshness, role/epoch/sequence checks, measured integrity/position, points, hardware feedback and watchdog
detection.coverage_evidence: Actual Rust tests and prototype twin; physical coverage not qualified
detection.delay: 100 ms output contract / 1 s input age / 3 s lease; assumptions awaiting measurement

mitigation.action: Inhibit traction, brake, retain resource ownership; qualified no-reentry/clearance and local recovery
mitigation.response_time: Prototype bounded contract only; HIL measurement pending
mitigation.recovery_conditions: Stopped, proved hardware/integrity/departure, reconciled owners and controlled procedure

risk.uncertainty: Uncalibrated sensors, brake, time, power and output independence

ownership.action: Independently review fault coverage, physical assumptions and residual risks before HIL/release
